verdict.rationale: Open WebUI's own docs say API keys let external code call the same endpoints the web UI uses, which directly states UI/API parity. A built-in Swagger UI documents those endpoints on a self-hosted instance. However, the Swagger UI is available only in dev mode, the REST API reference is labelled experimental, and no REST deprecation window is promised. Missing for 10: a published, stable OpenAPI spec (all probed paths 404), independent or hands-on confirmation of feature-by-feature parity, and REST API stability guarantees.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI

citations.quote: An API key is a personal access token that lets external code call the same endpoints the web UI uses.
Make sure to set the `ENV` environment variable to `dev` in order to access the Swagger documentation
